run.requirements: OpenSea-only sequential fixed-price Piggy Banks launch with public tier rotation

summary.building: A configurable fixed-tier mint policy used directly through OpenSea SeaDrop
summary.topRisk: OpenSea's single public stage requires correctly timed owner transactions and no concurrent SeaDrop routes
summary.mustDecideFirst: Retain launch-manager ownership through rotation or delay enough to use the 24-hour timelock
summary.watchOutFor: The existing NFT pins the superseded policy and cannot be reused

risks.title: Ambiguous concurrent routes
risks.detail: SeaDrop omits route parameters from the NFT callback, so production must keep mint routes mutually exclusive.

risks.title: Timed public rotation
risks.detail: The single public stage must be updated and verified at every public-tier boundary.

risks.title: Tier-scoped counters
risks.detail: Global supply counters would recreate an unintended sellout dependency; the policy must return tier-local counts.

risks.title: Public RPC throttling
risks.detail: The official public RPC is rate-limited and should not be the sole production provider.

risks.title: Embedded deployment bytecode size
risks.detail: NFT changes increase collection initcode, which must stay below the EIP-3860 limit.

preCodingDecisions.title: OpenSea-only routing
preCodingDecisions.detail: Use sequential allowlists followed by one rotating public stage; do not use a custom gateway.

preCodingDecisions.title: NFT ownership during rotation
preCodingDecisions.detail: Choose manager execution or a delayed launch compatible with the 24-hour timelock.

preCodingDecisions.title: Alternate mint paths
preCodingDecisions.detail: Keep token-gated, signed, and payer routes empty in the production manifest.

requirementsCorrections.detail: A custom payer gateway is unnecessary when all mint windows are mutually exclusive.
Public tier rotations require an NFT-owner transaction at every boundary.
Each tier's token-ID range, price, fee terms, inventory, and wallet limit are pinned in the mint policy.
